description: BB insufficient-data scenario: only 5 closes provided but period=20 requires at least 20. Calculate returns ErrInsufficientData. Also covers related validation failures: period < 2 returns ErrInvalidPeriod; multiplier <= 0 returns ErrInvalidMultiplier; NaN price returns ErrInvalidPrice.

expectedOutput.error: bollinger_bands: insufficient data: need at least period closes
expectedOutput.note: len(closes)=5 < period=20 → ErrInsufficientData. Other failure modes: period<2 → ErrInvalidPeriod; multiplier<=0 → ErrInvalidMultiplier; NaN/negative price → ErrInvalidPrice.
